We came in for an Easter dinner.  The selection from the menu was varied and catered to every taste from appetizer, through entree to dessert.  Beet salad perfect made with arugala leaves with a light dressing and crumbles of goat cheese.
For the appetizers, the Panelle (fried chickpea fritters) is so light and delicate and served with a ricotta mousse.  Artichoke appetizer was also delicious.  It's as if your nonna made it herself.
Entrees did not disappoint.  Ravioli Osso Buco is ravioli stuffed with beef short rib and the sauce is kissed with truffle oil.  Fantastic balance in the sauce, has enough acid to offset the richness of the Osso Buco ravioli gravy. Lamb chops must have been made in heaven.  Perfectly seasoned, perfect temperature and it was beyond tender.

Cannoli delicious and filled with fresh ricotta cream.

Kitchen was on point with the timing of the dishes.  We hardly waited 5 minutes between courses.  Really, really excellent service from the wait staff.

Lastly, Gennaro is the best host ever!  His enthusiasm and happy personality lights up the restaurant experience at O'Sfizio. He can teach a master class in hospitality.

February 2026 back for an updated review. We came here for Valentine’s Day and as always enjoyed our dinner and the atmosphere. I was greeted with a rose 🌹 for Valentine’s Day, staff is always so attentive they make you feel at home. Hospitality has become a big thing for me these days especially given the costs of going out to eat, I choose to spend our money at places like Bella Mama Rose. Stop in any time to have a delicious meal in a welcoming environment ❤️

We have experienced catering from Bella Mama Rose and a pizza party at the restaurant. The catering was for a tailgate during our football game, the sandwiches and salad were a hit. I’m picky about my chicken, usually when you order sandwiches the chicken ends up being dried out and on the tough side, these sandwiches were amazing. The chicken was just right, not cut too thin and didn’t dry out. I would say it was made fresh before the delivery and not preheated.

We hosted our team pizza party on a Saturday at the restaurant, we had one of their private spaces and had 50 people. The food did not disappoint, the salad was delicious, rice balls, bread sticks and fried calamari were a hit and the pizza was perfect for our group. I failed to take photos of the food but trust me, worth it! They even had our team logo on the screen for us and provided a speaker so we could have music in the room.

This is a great place for a group outing. The staff was accommodating/attentive and kept the food coming. Full disclosure, Bella Mama Rose is sponsoring our football team this season and we like to give back to our sponsors by hosting our get togethers with them when we can.

Thank you Justin and Ashely for your support and accommodating our group even with 20 kids who play tackle football. We’ll definitely plan another date.

Omar was friendly, professional, and made us feel very welcome. His excellent service truly made our dining experience even more enjoyable. We highly recommend Baci, and we especially appreciate Omar for taking such great care of us. We will definitely be coming back!

Cocktails were great and the service was excellent. A really pretty, clean place with clean, spacious bathrooms. A beautiful outside seating area, too.
And 2 Private dining rooms for events available upstairs.

text.text:
A place right by the water where the evening slows down and the sunset takes over the view. The bridge in the distance, soft light reflecting on the ocean, and that subtle feeling like you’ve stepped out of the city for a moment. Inside — clean, stylish. Outside — open space, music, a DJ, and that effortless lounge-by-the-water energy.

What stood out the most was the service. Even with a full crowd and a large outdoor area, the staff notices you right away. Quick, attentive, genuinely polite — and not just with us, but with everyone around. It felt smooth, easy, and well taken care of.

They also brought out warm bread with butter, which was a nice touch. The only small issue was that it was served on a regular dry napkin, so the bread stuck to it and had to be peeled off, which wasn’t the most convenient.

I had the arugula salad with added chicken — light, fresh, enjoyable, nothing over the top but exactly what it needed to be. This place isn’t about the food as much as it is about the feeling. It’s where you come for a cocktail, a sunset, and that calm, beautiful pause at the end of the day.

text.text: We went for Mother’s Day during brunch, it was disappointing. It was $50 per person and $25 per child. For a child they could only choose one item, we chose chicken fingers and it came out with 4 chicken fingers and some fries. Kids price was a total rip off. We were not allowed to order off the regular menu. The waitress was rude because we kept asking if one of the items was not brought and she was arguing that they brought It. Menu said bagels will come with cream cheese and locks listed separately but it ended up being cream cheese with locks. The avocado toast was sad. Food was just okay and drinks were mid. The view was nice and great place for kids to run around. I’m sure it would have been a better experience if we had a nicer waitress. Tip was charged at 20% automatically. I would not come back on a holiday

We met friends there from NJ for an after winter lunch vacation planing get together. The restaurant was picked because it was halfway between our houses. Our waiter and staff were outstanding and extremely accommodating. The food was very appealing visually and looked as delicious as it was when we ate it. It's definitely a place we will visit again when the outside tables can be used.
Update.
It's been a year since we all got together here for our annual vacation planing, over the winter luncheon and we all agree the food and service is still outstanding. If you haven't tried you should do so.
